title: AI News 3D Effects Catalog
purpose: Reusable 3D effects for AI-focused browser vlogs and virtual news rooms

ai_assistant_guide.how_to_use: Select an effect by id or category, then load it into the Three.js news room as a floating panel, lower-third, full-screen graphic, stage element, or cinematic hero reveal. Pair with relevant data. Animate in with scale, particle burst, bar growth, or dramatic rise, hold 4-8 seconds, then animate out.
ai_assistant_guide.when_to_use: Use standard callouts for everyday updates. Use cinematic/out-of-the-box effects (neural explosion, data waterfall, particle text, GPU sphere, agent swarm) for major model releases, breakthroughs, big funding, or high-impact moments.
best_practices: Reserve cinematic effects for the biggest stories
Use camera orbit or push-in during hero reveals
Switch to red theme for crisis or regulation stories
